title: First jobs on Franklin Street and playing quadrilles by ear
summary: He recounts his first jobs on Franklin Street with a bought bass, the waltz and quadrille dance sets and their five parts, and why playing by ear matters.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
